jobs.title: VP, AI/Multitech
jobs.description:
About Us

Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. We're a proud Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner; Salesforce Crest Partner; Microsoft Gold Certified Partner, and much more: our evolution has taken us well beyond a single platform, making us a multi-technology advisory and implementation partner across ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, and AI-driven solutions. What sets us apart is a "technical-first" approach, teams who understand both business logic and deep system architecture paired with a genuine belief that our people are our greatest strength, and that's who we invest in first.

The Opportunity

As Vice President, AI & Multitech, you'll position yourself and your team as the technology leaders clients turn to across Appficiency's full platform portfolio - spanning ERP, CRM, AI, and beyond. This is a role built for someone who thinks in ecosystems, not single platforms: you'll build and coach a team fluent across multiple technologies, shape long-term account strategy in step with our sales targets, and push AI-driven delivery efficiency to new heights. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales to shape regional strategy, ensuring the team you build reflects where the business is headed next.

What You’ll Do

Establish yourself and your team as unbiased, platform-agnostic technology leaders - the people clients trust to recommend the right solution, not just the one you know best
Champion delivery excellence across AI and multitech engagements, ensuring every project lands within scope, on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standard
Build, train, and coach a team that's genuinely fluent across multiple technology platforms, developing depth and breadth rather than single-platform specialists
Make team development a core measure of your own success, growing a bench of multitech-capable practitioners who can flex across ERP, CRM, and AI engagements
Shape your team's structure and capacity in step with the company's regional sales strategy, building capability where the business is headed next - not where it's been
Cultivate senior-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic accounts
Own the long-term account strategy for key customers, aligning phased delivery plans with Sales' targets and the client's evolving needs
Partner closely with Sales as a true co-owner of account growth - this is one of the most important relationships you'll build in this role
Push AI-driven delivery efficiency forward, keeping performance at or above the firm's defined benchmark.

What You’ll Bring

A genuine technologist at heart - deep, hands-on fluency across ERP and CRM platforms such as NetSuite and Salesforce, with no particular allegiance to either; what matters is credibility across the ecosystem, not expertise in a single tool
Direct, applied experience with AI and automation technologies - generative AI tooling, workflow automation platforms, or AI-driven analytics
Comfort operating across multiple technical domains simultaneously: ERP, CRM, AI/ML tooling, and productivity platforms, with credibility to speak to each without defaulting to a single specialty
A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred; relevant technical certifications (cloud platforms, AI/automation tools, or ERP/CRM-specific credentials) are a strong plus
10+ years in Professional Services leadership, with 7-8 of those years hands-on in systems implementation, integration, or automation-driven process re-engineering
A track record of managing distributed, cross-platform delivery teams across multiple regions on concurrent projects
Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including fluency in reading and acting on P&L statements
Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for specific client and regional needs

What Will Set You Apart

A genuine track record of building multitech delivery teams from the ground up, not just managing existing specialists
Demonstrated success leading AI-driven efficiency initiatives with measurable, provable results
Strong executive presence and credible technical authority that holds up in front of C-suite stakeholders and skeptical technical audiences alike
Experience aligning delivery capability with regional sales strategy, building teams ahead of where the business needs them to be
A career built on breadth across platforms rather than depth in just one - genuinely multitech, not multitech-adjacent

What Success Looks Like

AI delivery efficiency consistently meets or exceeds the firm's benchmark, with gains visible in client outcomes, not just internal metrics
Your team is recognized internally and externally as genuinely multitech - capable across platforms, not siloed by specialty
Regional team structure evolves in lockstep with the sales vision, so capability is never the bottleneck to growth
Your partnership with Sales is cited as a model for how Delivery and Sales should work together, with account plans consistently aligned to phased delivery and targets
Clients see you and your team as the unbiased technology authority they can trust, regardless of which platform the conversation starts with

jobs.title: Senior Director, Finance Transformation-EN
jobs.description:
Behind every success is a team of dedicated experts driving us forward. Our corporate functions don’t just support — they lead, shaping the company’s path and preparing clients and employees for the moments that matter. Be part of a team where your work makes a difference, with opportunities to grow, collaborate, and thrive.

The Senior Director, Finance Transformation
will play a key role in advancing CAE's finance transformation vision by translating enterprise priorities into a structured portfolio of measurable, technology-enabled improvements across the global Finance function.

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), this individual will serve as a strategic leader responsible for defining and driving the global Finance and enterprise transformation agenda. The role is focused on leading large-scale initiatives related to process optimization, margin improvement, cost efficiency, and digital transformation.

The incumbent will oversee the global Finance transformation roadmap and project portfolio, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and delivering measurable outcomes in financial performance, efficiency, scalability, growth enablement, and innovation. As a transformation leader, this individual will foster cross-functional collaboration, lead change management and communication efforts, and support executive decision-making through high-impact initiatives and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Define the global Finance transformation strategy and translate enterprise objectives and long-term business priorities into a clear and structured roadmap.
Own and govern the Finance Transformation portfolio, including prioritization, investment planning, and delivery of high-impact initiatives.
Establish and lead robust governance frameworks to ensure cross-functional alignment, accountability, and effective decision-making across global initiatives.
Lead the end-to-end delivery of large-scale transformation programs, including scope definition, resource allocation, risk management, and value realization.
Champion operational excellence and process standardization across the global Finance function by leveraging continuous improvement methodologies.
Lead the evaluation, selection, and deployment of strategic technologies, including automation, artificial intelligence, and advanced analytics, to improve the efficiency, control, and scalability of Finance operations.
Develop and execute the Finance transformation change management strategy, ensuring stakeholder engagement, adoption, and alignment across teams.
Partner with senior leaders across Finance, IT, and Business Units to identify, prioritize, and execute transformation opportunities while accelerating innovation.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), value-tracking mechanisms, and reporting processes to measure transformation impact and support executive decision-making.
Build organizational capability by coaching and developing Finance teams while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Lead post-implementation reviews to validate benefit realization, capture lessons learned, and strengthen governance and process ownership.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or postgraduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
15+ years of progressive leadership experience, including senior leadership roles within Finance.
Proven experience leading finance transformation programs within complex global organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong experience in project management and continuous improvement; Six Sigma certification is considered an asset.
Strategic mindset with the ability to translate organizational priorities into actionable plans, governance frameworks, and measurable outcomes.
Deep expertise in digital finance technologies, automation, artificial intelligence, and analytics platforms, with the ability to assess and implement practical solutions that enhance Finance effectiveness and scalability.
Significant experience in governance, stakeholder management, and executive-level influence.
Demonstrated ability to build relationships, drive results, inspire creativity, and foster innovation across functions and geographies.
Ability to lead through ambiguity, influence without direct authority, and align diverse stakeholder groups around common objectives.
High level of resilience and ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation capabilities.

Benefits

Comprehensive group insurance program.
Telemedicine program and Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP).
Employee Share Purchase Plan.
Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP).
CAE Defined Benefit Pension Plan.
Sabbatical leave program.
Flexible work arrangements.
Enhanced parental leave benefits.

About CAE

At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.

Regular

jobs.title: Director of Product, API & AI Orchestration
jobs.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

One Team

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

ABC Fitness is becoming the intelligent operating system for the global fitness industry — the infrastructure that powers how 40M+ members are discovered, joined, engaged, and retained across 40,000 operators in 100+ markets. The layer that makes this possible is our API and AI orchestration platform: the control plane that governs how data, agents, partners, and external AI assistants securely access ABC's system of record, payments rails, and member intelligence.

As Director of Product for API & AI Orchestration, you will own this platform end-to-end and build the team and strategy behind it. You will set the vision for how ABC exposes its capabilities — to our 400+ integration partners, to internal teams building embedded AI experiences, and to a new generation of AI agents and assistants via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — and stand up the roadmap, operating model, and commercial engine to deliver it. This is a rare mandate to build a new platform business at ABC: the interface between our data moat and the AI-native fitness economy, and a durable, monetizable revenue line contributing to our 2030 target of 10% of revenue from AI, API , and data.

What You’ll Do

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for ABC's API and AI orchestration platform — the control plane for access, permissions, audit, and monetization across the company — and align it with ABC's intelligent-OS and IPS platform strategy.
Build, lead, and grow a team of product managers, setting direction, coaching for growth, and establishing the operating rhythm and ways of working for the platform organization.
Define and own ABC's MCP strategy: how external AI assistants and agents discover and act on ABC capabilities (availability, pricing, booking, billing, member context) safely, with the right authentication, scoping, governance, and audit.
Own the platform P&L thinking and commercial model: usage-based and tiered monetization, entitlements, metering, and packaging that turn platform access into a scalable revenue line.
Treat the API as a flagship product — set the standard for developer and partner experience across documentation, onboarding, versioning, SDKs, sandbox, and self-serve so partners and internal teams build faster and stay on the platform.
Partner with engineering, security, and compliance leadership to make access governance a first-class capability — granular permissions, consent, audit trails, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA, PCI, SOC) built into the platform.
Act as a senior cross-functional leader across product, engineering, data, payments, GTM, and partnerships — building alignment, managing dependencies, and representing the platform in executive and board-level forums.
Shape the 400+ partner ecosystem strategy with business development, prioritizing the integrations, endpoints, and orchestration patterns that unlock the most partner and member value.
Define and own the KPIs and success metrics for the platform — adoption, partner activation, API reliability, and monetized consumption — and drive data-informed prioritization amid ambiguity and competing demand.
Serve as the internal and external evangelist for the platform, representing ABC with partners, prospective developers, analysts, and strategic customers.

What You’ll Need

15+ years in product management, including experience leading and growing product teams (managing PMs or managers).
A track record of owning API, platform, or developer-facing products end-to-end — from strategy through delivery — and treating them as products others build on.
Demonstrated success building or scaling a platform, API, or ecosystem business, including its commercial and monetization model.
Strong technical fluency: able to set direction on REST/GraphQL APIs, authentication and authorization (OAuth, scopes, tokens), webhooks, versioning, and API governance with senior engineering leaders.
Proven ability to translate a high-level platform vision into strategy, business cases, org design, and prioritized delivery across multiple teams.
Executive presence and communication skills — comfortable influencing at the leadership and board level and negotiating with stakeholders at all levels.
A degree from an accredited university or college, or equivalent relevant experience.

AND IT’S GREAT TO HAVE

Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agent tooling, function/tool calling, or LLM orchestration — and a clear point of view on how AI assistants should safely act on platform data.
Experience building monetization for platform or API products: usage-based pricing, metering, entitlements, and packaging.
Exposure to payments, fintech, CRM, or other systems-of-record where compliance, security, and data governance are core to the product.
Experience operating in a private-equity-backed or high-growth software environment with a focus on durable, profitable growth.
Strong leadership and team-player qualities, adept at building relationships and collaborating across functions and geographies.
Deep understanding of agile methodology and ceremonies, and the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously with ownership and accountability.
A growth mindset and familiarity with the fitness industry and modern fitness consumers.

Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is -

$174,000.00 - $202,000.00 CAD or 530,000.00 - 540,000.00 PLN- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU
:

Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO!
Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
Parental & Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws!
Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period.
Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here!

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION:

ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com.

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness.com

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
About the Job:

Reporting to the Chief Finance and Corporate Services Officer, the Director of Finance is responsible for strategic and operational leadership for the organization's financial management, planning, reporting, compliance, and fiscal sustainability. They ensure the integrity of financial systems, support organizational decision-making through accurate financial analysis, and maintain compliance with regulatory, funding, audit, and reporting requirements.

They are responsible for planning, organizing, and overseeing the Finance team through encouraging positive change/innovation. They ensure that strategic goals established by executives are translated into practical action and that relationships are maximized between employees and community partners.

Duties and Responsibilities: 

Strategic Financial Leadership

Serve as a key advisor on financial strategy, risk management, budgeting, forecasting, and business planning
Lead the development and monitoring of organizational financial plans and long-term fiscal strategies
Support funding proposals, business cases, RFPs, and organizational growth initiatives

Financial Management and Reporting

Oversee the preparation of accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports
Monitor organizational cash flow and financial performance
Analyze financial results, identify variances, and provide recommendations to support informed decision-making
Present financial information to the Sr. Leadership Team, Program teams, Funders, and regulatory bodies

Budgeting and Forecasting

Lead the annual budgeting process and ongoing forecasting activities
Collaborate with operational leaders to develop program budgets and funding requests
Ensure alignment between program plans, budget forecasts, and organizational objectives

Compliance, Audit and Internal Controls

Ensure compliance with all regulatory, tax, charitable, and funder reporting requirements
Establish and maintain effective internal controls, financial policies, and accounting procedures
Lead the annual external audit process and coordinate year-end financial activities
Ensure timely submission of all statutory and funder reporting requirements

Financial Systems and Process Improvement

Maintain the integrity and effectiveness of financial systems and reporting tools
Oversee financial software administration, upgrades, testing, and reporting functionality
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance financial processes, controls, and reporting 

Leadership and Stakeholder Relations

Provide leadership, coaching, and development to the Finance team
Build strong relationships with auditors, funders, government ministries, financial institutions, and other external stakeholders
Support organizational committees and leadership initiatives related to financial stewardship and accountability
Other duties as required as per the reporting Manager

Qualifications
:
Post-Secondary education in Finance, Accounting, or a related field required
5+ years Supervising and/or Managing employees
5-10 years’ experience in a Financial Accounting, Planning, and Analysis role
CPA or CFA designation preferred
Demonstrated experience in not-for-profit, healthcare, community services, government-funded, or broader public sector environment is preferred
Experience managing external audits, government reporting requirements, charitable reporting obligations, and funder accountability frameworks.
Advanced knowledge of accounting and financial reporting systems, including ERP platforms and reporting tools (e.g., Dynamics GP, Power BI, Microsoft Excel).
Demonstrated leadership experience coaching, developing, and mentoring finance staff.
High degree of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and professional judgment.
Experience and sensitivity in dealing with members of different cultural and racial backgrounds, including visible and invisible dimensions of diversity
Excellent verbal/written communication and interpersonal skills
Demonstrated ability to work without direct supervision in a team environment
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and financial data analytics platforms.
A vehicle, valid driver’s license, and adequate insurance coverage

Reporting Function:

The Director of Finance reports directly to the Chief Finance and Corporate Services Officer. They are responsible for overseeing and managing the Finance team and have the authority to hire/fire/discipline and manage accordingly. They work with both internal and external partners and interact with all levels within the organization. They are a support system, resource, and advocator for the team and organization.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

Day shifts (8:30am - 4:30pm | Monday – Friday) with the ability to work excess/overtime hours where required
Able to work well with internal and external clients
Able to drive, walk (site locations) regularly
Able to sit for prolonged periods of time
Able to answer and communicate telephone calls and general computer use
Computer screen use (multiple screens if applicable) for prolonged periods of time
Able to lift up to 20lbs (product, documents, etc.)
Travel by vehicle to community sites for client support as required

Ship Values:

Compassion, Hope, Inclusive, Respect, Professional

About Us

Services and Housing In the Province (SHIP) is a Provincial leader in the broader public sector that builds strategic partnerships and programs that support the fundamental rights for Housing and Health Services throughout the Peel Region, Dufferin County, Region of Waterloo and surrounding areas.
Our commitment to increase quality of life through health services and housing supports that promote mental and physical health and wellness is at the forefront of every employee we hire. We value compassion, hope, inclusiveness, respect, and professionalism.
Our organization has supported the region for over 35 years and employs over 550 passionately engaged employees ranging from office administration, nurses, and service health specialists to housing specialists all dedicated to the community, clients, and families.

Accessibility

“SHIP strives to be equitable and inclusive in all that we do. Equity is a core value, and we are committed to providing an inclusive selection process. We encourage applicants from equity deserving communities including women, Black, Indigenous, other racialized groups, 2SLGBTQ+ persons, individuals with disabilities and others who will contribute to and enrich the organization and its values. We are committed to inclusive, barrier-free recruitment, selection processes, and work environments. Please advise the People and Culture Department of any accommodations needed in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 and the Ontario Human Rights Code to ensure you have access to a fair and equitable process”.

Application Instructions

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply before October 14, 2026

Why Work For Us?

Work-Life Balance
SHIP believes a healthy work-life balance is essential for both professional success and personal well-being. We strive to create a company culture that values and supports the well-being of our employees, while also pushing innovation in our organization

Our Vision 

Quality Housing, Quality Services, Quality Lives

Our Mission 

To increase quality of life through health services and housing supports that promote mental and physical health and wellness

Our Culture 

Leader and innovative partner in the community. Our programs welcome employees into our caring, compassionate, and innovative culture. We listen; we know what it means, and why it matters.

Our Commitment 

People are at the forefront of our success. Below are just a few ways our full-time permanent staff have personal and professional success:
Competitive Salaries with Annual Performance Reviews
Comprehensive Health Plans
Group RRSP (5% Employer Contributions)
12 Paid Health, Wellness, and Sick Days
10 Paid Vacation Days

Generous Parental and Family Leave
Learning and Development Opportunities
Travel Allowances
Employee Assistance Program
Company Culture to be Proud of
Possibility to Create a Real Impact

5,000+ Clients and Residents served annually

500+ Dedicated, Respectful, Compassionate and Professional Employees

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We’re seeking a hands-on, strategic CFO to partner closely with the CEO in driving financial performance, capital strategy, and scalable growth across our North American business. This role blends high-level financial leadership with day-to-day execution in a fast-moving, product-oriented environment.
The CFO will oversee all financial functions across North America including accounting, FP&A, payroll, and acquisition support; while playing a key role in capital allocation, fundraising, and strategic transactions. This leader will also help evolve the finance function through systems, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & CEO Partnership

Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the CEO on financial, strategic, and capital-related matters
Translate company strategy into financial plans, forecasts, and KPIs
Support decision-making on pricing, expansion, capital allocation, and investments
Help drive company-wide accountability through data and performance metrics

Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Own budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning across North American operations
Build and refine financial models across revenue streams and operating segments
Deliver actionable insights on revenue, margins, and key business drivers
Establish dashboards and reporting cadence for leadership and board-level visibility

Capital Strategy & Fundraising

Support and lead fundraising initiatives, including debt and/or equity financing
Manage relationships with lenders, investors, and financial partners
Assist in optimizing capital structure and funding strategy to support growth
Prepare materials for board, investors, and financing processes

M&A / Acquisition Support

Support the CEO in evaluating acquisition opportunities, partnerships, and strategic investments
Build financial models, valuations, and scenario analyses for potential transactions
Lead or support financial due diligence, including quality of earnings and risk assessment
Assist with deal structuring, financing considerations, and integration planning
Help ensure smooth financial integration post-acquisition (systems, reporting, controls)

Accounting, Payroll & Financial Operations

Oversee accounting, financial reporting, payroll, and month-end close processes
Ensure accurate and timely payroll across US and Canadian employees, including compliance with applicable regulations
Ensure compliance with North American financial, tax, and payroll requirements
Maintain strong internal controls and audit readiness
Optimize systems and workflows for efficiency and scalability

Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

Manage cash flow, liquidity, and banking relationships
Optimize working capital, including inventory and receivables/payables cycles
Align financial strategy with operational realities of a product-based business

Operational Finance

Partner with operations and commercial teams to improve margins and efficiency
Analyze profitability across products, channels, and customer segments
Support planning, forecasting, and vendor negotiations
Drive cost discipline while enabling growth

Systems, Data & Finance Enablement

Improve financial systems, reporting, and data infrastructure
Support adoption of automation and emerging technologies
Enhance visibility and speed of decision-making through better data integration
Build scalable processes to support growth

Team Leadership

Lead and develop a small but high-performing finance and payroll team
Build scalable processes appropriate for a growing organization
Foster a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement

Qualifications

Experience

10–15+ years in finance, with experience as a CFO, VP Finance, or Senior Finance leader
Proven exposure to M&A, acquisitions, or strategic transactions
Experience supporting or leading fundraising / financing activities
Experience in product-based, distribution, or operationally complex businesses
Experience operating across North America (including payroll, tax, and compliance considerations)
Experience across both high-growth and more established environments preferred

Skills & Capabilities

Strong financial modeling and analytical skills
Experience supporting acquisition models, diligence, and integration processes
Solid understanding of cross-border payroll and compliance
Strong grasp of unit economics and business drivers
Ability to operate both strategically and tactically
Systems-oriented mindset (ERP, payroll, inventory, and reporting tools)

Leadership Style

Direct, pragmatic, and solutions-oriented
Low ego, high ownership, high agency
Comfortable challenging assumptions and driving clarity
Able to simplify complex financial concepts for non-financial stakeholders

What Success Looks Like

Clear, reliable financial visibility across the business
Successful support and execution of financing and acquisition initiatives
Accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll operations across US and Canada
Improved margins and disciplined cost structure
Strong cash flow and working capital management
Finance function that scales with growth without becoming bureaucratic
CEO has a highly trusted partner for financial and strategic decisions

jobs.title: Associate Director, Investment Platform (Contract)
jobs.description:
BMO Private Wealth is one of Canada's leading wealth management businesses, serving affluent individuals, families, business owners, and institutions. The Investment Platform team is responsible for advancing the investment solutions, programs, and platform capabilities that support investment professionals and enhance client outcomes across the wealth business .

The Associate Director, Investment Platform leads strategic investment management and platform initiatives from concept through implementation, ensuring projects deliver measurable business value, enhance client and advisor outcomes, and support the achievement of investment program objectives. Oversees the full project lifecycle, balancing investment management priorities, regulatory requirements, operational considerations, and stakeholder expectations to deliver successful outcomes on time, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards. Proactively identifies and mitigates execution, business, and implementation risks to achieve desired investment and business results. Serves as a key liaison between investment management, product, operations, technology, compliance, and other stakeholders, facilitating effective communication and alignment across functions. Directs, manages, and coordinates cross-functional teams, including project managers, investment professionals, business and technology resources, user groups, internal and external consultants, vendors, and regulatory bodies, to drive the successful delivery of complex investment initiatives and strategic business change.

Supports initiatives primarily within Wealth Management and Investment Management while contributing to broader business and enterprise objectives.
Partners with stakeholders across investment management, technology, operations, compliance, and governance teams to advance business and project objectives.
Provides specialized consulting, analytical, and project leadership expertise in support of investment management programs and business initiatives.
Works independently while managing multiple priorities and navigating complex or ambiguous situations.
Supports the development and execution of strategic plans, investment platform initiatives, and business transformation programs.
Leads small to medium-scale investment management, platform, and business transformation initiatives involving multiple stakeholder groups.
Helps define business priorities, initiative roadmaps, and execution plans to support the achievement of investment and organizational objectives.
Conducts analysis of business, operational, and investment-related issues, providing insights and recommendations to support strategic decisions.
Supports and manages project budgets, forecasts, business cases, and benefit realization tracking.
Analyzes data and key performance indicators to identify opportunities, risks, and areas for optimization.
Monitors project performance against established objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards, and addresses issues proactively.
Coordinates and influences cross-functional teams, including business, technology, operations, compliance, and external partners, to achieve project outcomes.
Supports vendor management activities, including contract oversight, resource planning, and delivery management in partnership with Strategic Sourcing.
Provides project sponsors and business leaders with recommendations regarding implementation approaches, risks, dependencies, and sustainment plans.
Manages all phases of the project lifecycle, ensuring delivery of business, operational, regulatory, and technology-related objectives.
Partners with stakeholders to develop and execute change management plans that support adoption of new investment solutions, processes, and capabilities.
Ensures projects comply with established governance frameworks, risk management standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
Develops and maintains project management deliverables, executive reporting materials, governance documentation, and implementation plans.
Monitors project risks, dependencies, and interconnections and implements mitigation strategies to support successful delivery.
Evaluates project health, business case assumptions, expected benefits, and performance metrics throughout the project lifecycle.
Builds strong relationships with sponsors and stakeholders through effective communication, collaboration, and transparency.
Demonstrates accountability and ownership by identifying and resolving project issues and escalating concerns when appropriate.

About the Role:

The Director of Digital Product Management
for Medical Writing will lead the vision, strategy, and lifecycle of a global portfolio of AI-enabled products that help medical writers create high-quality, scientifically accurate, and compliant clinical documents. The portfolio includes a live informed-consent-form assistant and is expanding toward reusable capabilities across multiple medical-writing document types, including informed consent forms (ICFs), clinical study reports (CSRs), safety narratives, investigator's brochures, and clinical protocols.

This role is the senior product connection between Medical Writing and clinical development stakeholders, the PPD Digital Product Domain Head, technology teams, and delivery partners. It owns product outcomes from discovery and roadmap definition through delivery, adoption, production performance, and value realization. Success requires strong product judgment, deep customer empathy, and the ability to lead AI-enabled clinical products in regulated environments where human accountability, traceability, data protection, and quality are built into every release.

This is a remote role for qualified candidates in the US or Canada.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

Define and communicate the product vision, multi-year strategy, and outcome-based roadmap for the AI Medical Writing portfolio.
Translate Medical Writing and clinical development priorities into a coherent portfolio of reusable product capabilities rather than disconnected point solutions.
Act as the senior product partner to business leaders and the PPD Digital Product Domain Head, creating clarity on product outcomes, priorities, investment choices, dependencies, and trade-offs.
Build strong product-management practices and coach product owners and cross-functional contributors, establishing clear decision rights and accountability.

Product Discovery and Clinical Workflow

Develop a deep understanding of medical writers, reviewers, approvers, and operational users through direct discovery, workflow observation, user research, and Voice of Customer activities.
Define intended users, problems to solve, use cases, requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable success outcomes for each capability and document workflow.
Ensure products support human-in-the-loop authoring and review, with appropriate source traceability, version lineage, scientific integrity, and final accountability retained by qualified users.
Represent the full content lifecycle, including authoring, review, amendment, approval, reuse, and downstream submission or archival needs.

Execution Delivery and Partner Leadership

Lead a global, matrixed delivery model spanning product, engineering, data science, user experience, quality and validation, information security, operations, and external vendors.
Own product scope, backlog priorities, release goals, acceptance criteria, definition of done, and product readiness decisions, balancing speed, quality, risk, and user value.
Set clear expectations for delivery partners and vendors; manage outcomes, quality, timelines, dependencies, escalations, and transparent communication with senior stakeholders.
Partner with technical leaders on build, buy, and partner choices and on architectures that support secure, scalable, maintainable, and reusable capabilities.

AI Product Quality and Regulated Use

Shape product requirements for generative AI and other automation approaches, working with engineering and data-science leaders to evaluate feasibility, limitations, performance, and operating risk.
Establish product-level quality measures and evaluation approaches for content accuracy, completeness, consistency, critical errors, reviewer effort, and appropriate use.
Embed responsible AI, privacy, security, validation, auditability, and regulatory expectations into product decisions in partnership with the relevant control functions.
Ensure release evidence demonstrates that each capability is fit for its intended use and that known limitations, fallbacks, and human review responsibilities are clear.

Lifecycle Adoption and Value

Own the full product lifecycle from opportunity discovery and business case through launch, production support, continuous improvement, and retirement or replacement decisions.
Define and monitor product measures covering adoption, user experience, document quality, cycle time, review effort, reliability, operational efficiency, and business value.
Lead launch readiness, stakeholder communications, training, change enablement, and feedback loops so capabilities are embedded in day-to-day Medical Writing practice
Use production insights, support themes, defects, and user feedback to continually refine priorities and improve product outcomes.

Market Customer and Commercial Insight

Monitor the external market, customer needs, emerging AI capabilities, competitors, and regulatory expectations to inform differentiation and product positioning.
Develop clear value propositions and evidence-based business cases in partnership with finance, commercial, operational, and technology stakeholders.
Represent the portfolio with senior internal and external audiences, translating complex clinical and technical topics into clear product choices and outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

Medical writers and reviewers adopt the products because they make priority workflows easier, faster, and more reliable
without compromising scientific or regulatory quality.

The portfolio advances through a clear, outcome-led roadmap
with timely decisions, transparent trade-offs, and dependable delivery across internal teams and vendors.

AI-enabled capabilities
are evaluated and released against explicit intended-use and quality criteria, with traceability and human oversight designed in.

Capabilities scale across document types
through shared components, governed content and evidence, and reusable product patterns.

Investment decisions are supported by credible measures
of adoption, quality, efficiency, customer value, and operational impact.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, technology, business, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.
Previous progressive product-management experience, including senior leadership of complex digital products or portfolios that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 10+ years’ experience).
Demonstrated ownership of the full product lifecycle, including discovery, strategy, roadmap, delivery, launch, adoption, performance management, and value realization.
Experience in clinical research, drug development, Medical Writing, regulatory content, or another highly regulated life-sciences environment is strongly preferred.
Experience delivering AI, machine-learning, analytics, or workflow-automation products; practical familiarity with generative AI is highly desirable.
Experience leading global, cross-functional teams and third-party delivery partners in a matrixed organization.
In some cases an equivalency, consisting of appropriate education, training, and/or directly related experience will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge Skills And Abilities

Strong product leadership: able to move between strategic portfolio choices, detailed workflow decisions, delivery trade-offs, and executive communication.
Working knowledge of clinical-document authoring and review, including the quality, traceability, confidentiality, and regulatory expectations associated with clinical content.
AI fluency sufficient to collaborate effectively with technical teams and to make informed decisions about model quality, evaluation, limitations, governance, and user experience.
Excellent stakeholder and vendor leadership, with the confidence to create alignment, challenge assumptions, resolve ambiguity, and make timely decisions.
Strong customer orientation and discovery skills, with the ability to convert user needs into clear product requirements and scalable capabilities.
Commercial and analytical acumen, including business cases, portfolio prioritization, product metrics, and evidence-based value tracking.
Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex clinical, product, and technical topics to different audiences.
Sound judgment, resilience, and a collaborative leadership style suited to global teams operating across multiple time zones.

will play a key role in advancing CAE's finance transformation vision by translating enterprise priorities into a structured portfolio of measurable, technology-enabled improvements across the global Finance function.

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), this individual will serve as a strategic leader responsible for defining and driving the global Finance and enterprise transformation agenda. The role is focused on leading large-scale initiatives related to process optimization, margin improvement, cost efficiency, and digital transformation.

The incumbent will oversee the global Finance transformation roadmap and project portfolio, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and delivering measurable outcomes in financial performance, efficiency, scalability, growth enablement, and innovation. As a transformation leader, this individual will foster cross-functional collaboration, lead change management and communication efforts, and support executive decision-making through high-impact initiatives and reporting.

Lead the end-to-end delivery of large-scale transformation programs, including scope definition, resource allocation, risk management, and value realization.
